subject: Goodwill credits & trial extension request after Snowflake integration latency incident
messages:
From: Alice Chu <alice.chu@snowflake.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Snowflake Platform Ops <platform-ops@snowflake.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Production latency spike Sept 10 — request for credits & trial extension

Hi Marissa,

We experienced a significant latency regression on Sept 10 between 03:15–04:10 UTC impacting our ingestion pipelines. Responses from the Redwood hosted endpoint spiked from ~120ms to >1.2s and a handful of important batch jobs timed out and had to be retried. We're still reconciling the business impact but have an initial estimate of ~150K rows delayed and a missed SLA for a partner sync.

This incident happened during our trial / onboarding window and has materially affected our evaluation timeline. Can Redwood provide: 1) goodwill credits to offset the operational cost of retries, and 2) a 30-day trial extension so we can complete the remaining end-to-end tests?

Ticket ref: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/48722
Attached: incident_timeline_20260912.csv (timeline + sample traces)

We appreciate a prompt response — our procurement and platform teams need this to finish procurement.

Regards,
Alice
Alice Chu
Platform Reliability Engineer, Snowflake

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chu <alice.chu@snowflake.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike Sept 10 — request for credits & trial extension

Hi Alice — thank you for the details and the timeline attachment. I’m really sorry you hit this during onboarding — we know that’s a bad look and we want to make this right.

I’ve opened an ops escalation and asked infra to prioritize the RCA and trace analysis. I’m also looping finance and my sales lead to assess a one-time goodwill credit and coordinate a trial extension. I should be able to confirm a concrete proposal by EOD PDT today.

For transparency, we usually handle these as a combination of a one-time credit tied to the incident and a limited trial extension; I’ll share the proposed numbers and the accounting note for approval.

– Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Production latency spike Sept 10 — Snowflake asking for credits & 30d extension

Forwarding Snowflake's note (below). They hit a latency regression during their trial and are requesting goodwill credits plus a 30-day extension. Attached is my quick napkin calc (proposed_credit_note_20260912.pdf) with three options.

Short summary / ask:
- Impact: transient latency spike, customer delayed ingestion jobs — potential operational cost for retries
- Recommendation: approve a one-time credit in the $8k–$12k range + 30-day trial extension
- Considerations: precedent for trial extensions; need to tag as one-time promotional credit in accounting; record HubSpot deal/notes (HS-89321).

Options (high level):
A) $8,000 credit, 30-day trial extension — conservative, minimizes precedent
B) $10,000 credit, 30-day extension — balances impact & retention odds (my preferred)
C) $12,000 credit + 30d extension — more generous given SLA-type impact

Please reply-all with approval or a counter. If we agree, I’ll send a formal credit memo + DocuSign payment amendment and close the loop with Snowflake.

Attachments: proposed_credit_note_20260912.pdf

-----Original Message-----
(Original customer message appended)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production latency spike Sept 10 — Snowflake asking for credits & 30d extension

Thanks for the context, Marissa. I reviewed the incident timeline — looks like an edge-case GC interaction that caused a momentary stall. Ops will need to include the workaround in docs.

I’m OK with Option A ($8k + 30d) as a baseline. If we believe Snowflake is strategic and likely to convert quickly, we could stretch to $10k, but we should cap at $10k and mark this as "one-time goodwill" to avoid creating a repeatable playbook without review.

If accounting needs a code, put it under promotion_credit_q3_2026. Please capture the HubSpot note.

- Sean

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production latency spike Sept 10 — Snowflake asking for credits & 30d extension

Marissa / Sean — I pushed on revenue prediction for this account; procurement expects a mid-Q4 close and the integration looks like it will be sticky. Given the trial timing and the fact this affected a partner sync, I’d prefer Option B ($10k) to keep momentum in the deal. If we do $10k, we should add a short remediation note (ops RCA + follow-up call) so Snowflake sees we're investing in reliability.

Happy to authorize $10k. Rishi

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production latency spike Sept 10 — Snowflake asking for credits & 30d extension

Thanks all for the quick turn. I agree with Rishi — approve $10,000 one-time goodwill credit and a 30-day trial extension. Make sure accounting tags this as promotion_credit_q3_2026 and that legal signs off on any amendment language.

Marissa — please send the formal credit memo and the DocuSign link to Snowflake. Also schedule a brief technical post-mortem with their platform team; ops should lead.

Lauren
Head of Sales Operations (acting)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chu <alice.chu@snowflake.com>
Cc: Snowflake Platform Ops <platform-ops@snowflake.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T10:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike Sept 10 — request for credits & trial extension

Hi Alice — thanks again for the timeline and for flagging this. We’ll apply a one-time goodwill credit of $10,000 to your account (appears on the October invoice) and we’re extending your trial window by 30 days from your original expiry.

Next steps:
- Attached: credit_memo_20260913.pdf (official credit memo)
- Please sign the DocuSign amendment to confirm the promotional extension: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=xyz123
- Ops will reach out to schedule a 30–45 minute post-incident call and share the RCA + mitigation plan within 72 hours.

We appreciate your patience while we sorted this out. If you need the credit applied differently (e.g., immediate refund vs invoice credit), let me know and I’ll loop in finance.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: credit_memo_20260913.pdf
